description: Declares which app can open records of given collections, mapping each record collection to a deep-link URL template.

name.description: Denormalized app display name, for convenience.

targets.description: Collections this app can open, one entry per destination. A collection that opens in more than one place (e.g. a list-item opens either the list or the added member) appears in multiple entries, each with its own label.

collection.description: Record collection NSID this app can open.

template.description: URL template for opening such a record. Placeholders: {repo} (handle if known else DID), {handle}, {did}, {rkey}, {collection}, and {value.<dot.path>} into the record body. A placeholder may dereference another record with '->': {value.subject->name} fetches the at:// URI at value.subject and reads its 'name' (chainable: a->b->c). An optional '|transform' (atUriAuthority, atUriRkey, atUriCollection) extracts a piece of an at:// URI, e.g. {value.subject|atUriAuthority} or {value.subject->repo|atUriAuthority}.

label.description: Human label for this destination, e.g. "List" — used to disambiguate when a collection has more than one entry.
